newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amplats plans to merge platinum interests.
newsitem.headline: Amplats plans to merge platinum interests.

text.p: Anglo American Platinum Corp (Amplats) of South Africa Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to merge its four listed companies which at present constitute the group -- Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd (Rusplat), Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd (Leplat), Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd (PP Rust) and Amplats itself.
Amplats said in a statement that it hoped to make a further announcement within two months detailing the proposed merger.

"The proposed restructuring supports the Amplats group's strategy of moving its operations down the cost curve and increasing operational flexibility to take full advantage of market conditions by facilitating optimal use of its combined asset base," it said.
The merger, together with the development of a new mine at Boschkoppie and expansion of PP Rust's concentrator, would enhance Amplats position as world leader in platinum, it said.
